title: PhantomPlay Unity Compatibility Project
design_pillars: Every flagship launches in its own independently resizable native window.
Gameplay systems must be real, responsive, and testable rather than decorative.
This project is retained as migration evidence and a compatibility fixture, not as the runtime for the three Unreal flagships.
PhantomPlay continues to accept and launch unrelated Unity games through its engine adapter.
visual_direction: Purpose-built presentation instead of Unity defaults.
Readable combat silhouettes, coherent materials, intentional lighting, and visible gameplay feedback.
Rendered-frame inspection is required before visual work is called complete.

audio_direction.rule: Unity does not synthesize or replace primary game music.
